Cinematic 15-second video in ultra-realistic 4K, dramatic filmic style, warm golden hour lighting with god rays streaming through wooden blinds, moody luxury office interior with dark wood paneling and elegant furniture.

An elderly distinguished man (late 60s, silver-gray slicked-back hair, full well-groomed gray beard, sharp facial features) wearing a black tuxedo with white bow tie sits in a classic dark leather armchair. A large fluffy ginger tabby cat is comfortably sitting on his lap. He slowly and gently strokes the cat's back with his right hand while looking at it affectionately.

At around 6–7 seconds, he carefully lifts and places the ginger cat down onto the floor. The cat jumps off his lap and walks away. The man then slowly rises from the chair, turns his body to the right with a serious, contemplative expression, and looks toward the background where several other men in dark suits are standing near a doorway, observing him.

Smooth, elegant camera movement: starts with a medium shot focused on the man and cat, slowly pans right and pulls back slightly as he stands up, revealing more of the luxurious office and the waiting men. Subtle lens flares, rich color grading, cinematic depth of field, photorealistic details, 4K resolution, 24fps, high production quality like a Hollywood drama scene.

Un hombre mayor distinguido (finales de los 60, cabello plateado-gris peinado hacia atrás, barba gris bien cuidada, rasgos faciales afilados) vestido con un esmoquin negro y pajarita blanca se sienta en un clásico sillón de cuero oscuro.
